title: Laser-induced graphene as a versatile platform for colloidal quantum dot heterostructure photodetectors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47360-47365
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07157G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiyoon Oh, Donggu Lee, Kyoungeun Lee, Yeyun Bae, Jaeyeop Lee, Yeong Uk Kim, Byeong Guk Jeong, Jaehoon Kim, Hanchul Cho, Jeongkyun Roh
Maskless and simple laser fabrication produces porous laser-induced graphene (LIG) that serves as an excellent platform for integrating PbS quantum dots into high-performance heterostructure photodetectors.
